teaser_copy.seo_title: Currents of Perception: Generative Geometric Constructivist Abstraction Landscapes
teaser_copy.seo_description: An abstract generative series exploring perception through geometric currents, constructivist colored landscapes, and emergent figures that suggest a psychic motion.
teaser_copy.page_subtitle: Generative geometric abstractions create constructivism landscapes
tile_text: Geometric mountains tower over brightly colored figures
Generative process refined with disciplined finishing

page_copy.pattern: Abstract landscape work thrives on motion cues, color harmonies, and geometric repetition that guide the eye through space without fixed boundaries.
page_copy.action: A generative pipeline sketched core geometry and palette, then in painting and value control established edge discipline, focal emergence, and layered color depth.
page_copy.measured: Delivers cohesive series pieces that read clearly at grid scale and reward close inspection for print, social showcases, and provenance linked digital editions.
